I’m telling you this now… sorry guys 😅 but don’t blindly believe that AI will keep needing more and more tokens forever.

Yes, AI usage may increase, but at the same time AI is also becoming much smarter and more efficient.

In the future, AI may not need to waste huge tokens to complete one task. It will understand what humans want better, plan better, write code faster, and finish work in fewer steps.

Also, with better hardware, better optimization, and cheaper inference, AI prices can become very low.

We are already seeing this with models like DeepSeek and other fast-improving AI models. There is a real possibility that small AI agents running on normal PCs can do the same type of work that today’s top-tier cloud agents are doing.

So I don’t think the future is only about “more tokens = more cost” 🤔

The real future may be smarter AI, cheaper AI, and agents that waste fewer tokens but complete bigger tasks.

So don’t panic when people say AI will become too expensive. Just learn how to use AI properly. The people who learn AI tools, agents, and automation early will be far ahead of others.
